description: Error counts, real-time factor, and peak memory that `Tools/natural-speech-eval.py score` printed for the runs `final-qwen-0.6b` (the Swift runtime with build/0.6b, file mode) and `transformers-0.6b` (reference_runs.py). The keys and fields follow the score command's results/asr.json, so a new score output can replace this file. The run files were in /tmp and no longer exist.
conditions: Another speech pipeline (Parakeet with diarization on cpuAndGPU) used the GPU during most of the final-qwen-0.6b runs, so real-time factors are high.

sets.fleurs-zh: FLEURS cmn_hans_cn, first 100 test files, character error rate
sets.fleurs-ja: FLEURS ja_jp, first 100 test files, character error rate
sets.fleurs-ko: FLEURS ko_kr, first 100 test files, character error rate
sets.fleurs-yue: FLEURS yue_hant_hk, first 100 test files, character error rate after OpenCC t2s conversion of both texts
sets.ls-clean-utt: LibriSpeech test-clean, 252 utterances (about 30 minutes), word error rate
sets.ls-other-utt: LibriSpeech test-other, 281 utterances (about 30 minutes), word error rate
